C2 (Rare but high-intensity rainfall): 1.0/2 — wet on 2.6% of days; the wettest 1% of days are 1.3x a typical wet day (p99=2.65mm, p50_wet=2.07mm) (data/processed/features/catchment_rainfall_climatology.parquet). C3 (Reef or seagrass within a few kilometres): 1.0/2 — 3628 m from the box centroid to the nearest named reef zone (data/processed/vectors/reef_zones.gpkg). C4 (Narrow shelf or restricted-flushing basin): 0.0/2 — depth range 1092 m across 44550 sampled cells (narrow range is the shallow-basin proxy) (data/processed/bathymetry/depth_utm36n.tif). C5 (Development at the outlet): 2.0/2 — 459 real OSM building footprints inside this box (data/processed/vectors/osm_aqaba.gpkg). C6 (Data-poor and unmonitored): insufficient data — whether other monitoring/gauge infrastructure exists elsewhere is a desk-research judgement, not a computable geospatial fact — no automated evidence source exists for this criterion, for any location.

caveats.message: This six-criterion rubric was built and tuned against exactly one site — Aqaba. A score for any other coordinate is the rubric's first real test, not a validated instrument.
